key.name: macros
key.description: All macros, steps and conditions, serialised as JSON

key.name: active-macro-id
key.description: Id of the macro the popup and shortcuts act on

key.name: open-popup
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that opens the clickmate popup

key.name: run-macro
key.summary: Run or stop the selected macro
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that toggles playback of the selected macro

key.name: record-toggle
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that toggles recording into the selected macro

key.name: pick-point
key.description: Capture the pointer position for use as a click target or pixel check

key.name: panic-stop
key.description: Abort any running macro and release every held key

key.name: toggle-autoclicker
key.description: Kept so existing configurations keep loading; use run-macro instead

key.name: llm-endpoint
key.description: OpenAI-compatible endpoint used for screenshot questions

key.name: llm-model
key.description: Model identifier passed to the endpoint

key.name: llm-api-key
key.description: Sent as a bearer token when set; usually empty for local servers

key.name: llm-timeout-ms
key.description: How long to wait for the model before giving up, in milliseconds

key.name: llm-max-width
key.description: Screenshots are scaled down to this width before being sent

key.name: llm-jpeg-quality
key.description: Quality of the screenshot encoding sent to the model

key.name: control-socket
key.description: Unix socket the daemon serves its JSON API on

key.name: event-socket
key.description: Unix socket the daemon streams recorded input events on

key.name: neutralize-pointer-accel
key.description: Temporarily set a flat mouse acceleration profile so absolute moves land exactly

key.name: saved-accel-profile
key.description: Internal: the profile to restore after playback

key.name: saved-pointer-speed
key.description: Internal: the pointer speed to restore after playback

key.name: record-delays
key.description: Insert wait steps for idle gaps while recording

key.name: record-gap-ms
key.description: Idle gaps longer than this become wait steps

key.name: record-motion
key.description: Record intermediate pointer movement instead of only click positions

key.name: record-raw
key.description: Store the untouched event train instead of readable steps; needed for games

key.name: log-level
key.description: One of error, warn, info, debug
